chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Elliot Anderson played for England at the 2026 World Cup, where they won bronze. This is how he wins the ball and drives forward. He reads the pass, steps in... and he is away!

chapters.label: Read the pass
chapters.text: Watch again. He watches the passer, then steps across at just the right moment.

chapters.label: Head up, go
chapters.text: Now he lifts his head, sees the space in front, and carries the ball into it, fast.

chapters.label: Win it and drive
chapters.text: Like Anderson: win the ball, lift your head, and carry it forward into the space in front of you.
